name: TOB AI Settings
description: Single, global defaults for AI generation — a whitelisted method's own default parameters when a caller doesn't override them. Not a per-request override mechanism.

fields.label: Default Temperature
fields.description: Kept low by default — Bible explanation/Q&A content should be consistent and grounded, not creative.

fields.label: Default Language
fields.description: Used when a caller specifies no language at all — normally the Language row with Is Default checked, but overridable here independently.

fields.label: Append AI-Generated Disclaimer
fields.description: Whether generated Bible content should carry a footer distinguishing it from Scripture text itself, matching the product's own 'never present speculation as biblical fact' requirement.
